All keeps the text of a hidden element and template content

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["hiddenContent" => "All"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
